title: Parent and Framework task delivery did not bind origin effective push destination to the expected user repository
title_de: Parent- und Framework-Task-Delivery band das effektive Origin-Push-Ziel nicht an das erwartete Benutzer-Repository
profile: local Parent and Framework governance delivery boundary
summary: The normal Parent and Framework task-branch delivery path displayed remote configuration but did not require both origin fetch and effective push URL, expected GitHub identity, writable permission, archive state, and default branch before branch creation, push, PR, or remote deletion. A mismatched origin.pushurl could therefore evade a display-only preflight.
summary_de: Der normale Parent- und Framework-Task-Branch-Delivery-Pfad zeigte die Remote-Konfiguration an, verlangte aber vor Branch-Erstellung, Push, PR oder Remote-Löschung nicht sowohl Origin-Fetch- als auch effektive Push-URL, erwartete GitHub-Identität, Schreibberechtigung, Archivstatus und Default-Branch. Ein abweichendes origin.pushurl konnte somit einen reinen Anzeige-Preflight umgehen.
observed_behavior: The scoped governance scan found that normal Parent and Framework delivery instructions used git remote display evidence before git push -u origin and PR creation, without an invariant that the effective push URL resolves to the expected Easton97-Jens repository. The scan did not change remotes or attempt a push.
observed_behavior_de: Der abgegrenzte Governance-Scan stellte fest, dass normale Parent- und Framework-Delivery-Anweisungen vor git push -u origin und PR-Erstellung nur git-remote-Anzeige-Evidence nutzten, ohne die Invariante, dass die effektive Push-URL auf das erwartete Easton97-Jens-Repository aufgelöst wird. Der Scan änderte keine Remotes und unternahm keinen Push-Versuch.
expected_behavior: Before every delivery-branch creation, push, PR action, or remote-branch deletion, the owning repository must verify origin fetch and effective push URLs against the exact expected user repository, confirm GitHub identity, non-archived writable state and default branch, and stop as blocked_remote_mismatch on any mismatch.
expected_behavior_de: Vor jeder Delivery-Branch-Erstellung, jedem Push, jeder PR-Aktion oder Remote-Branch-Löschung muss das besitzende Repository Origin-Fetch- und effektive Push-URL gegen das exakte erwartete Benutzer-Repository prüfen, GitHub-Identität, nicht archivierten beschreibbaren Status und Default-Branch bestätigen und bei jeder Abweichung als blocked_remote_mismatch stoppen.
impact: A local operator error or hostile local Git configuration could redirect a normal task-branch delivery or deletion to an unintended destination despite a remote display check. The scan found no demonstrated attacker-controlled delivery sink or outbound misuse; this is low-severity governance hardening rather than a validated runtime exploit.
impact_de: Ein lokaler Bedienfehler oder eine bösartige lokale Git-Konfiguration könnte eine normale Task-Branch-Delivery oder -Löschung trotz Remote-Anzeigeprüfung auf ein unbeabsichtigtes Ziel umleiten. Der Scan fand keinen nachgewiesenen angreiferkontrollierten Delivery-Sink oder ausgehenden Missbrauch; dies ist Low-Severity-Governance-Hardening und kein validierter Runtime-Exploit.
preconditions: An authorized Parent or Framework delivery action is about to create a branch, push, create/update a PR, or delete a remote branch.
The local origin fetch URL, origin.pushurl/effective push URL, or GitHub identity differs from the expected repository and the task relies only on display evidence.
reproduction: Inspect the retained scan report and the pre-fix delivery policies for display-only git remote evidence followed by a normal origin push.

Run the focused policy audits and Framework negative fixture after the patch; a direct-master weakening in git-policy.md is now read by the audit, and remote preflight text requires both URLs and GitHub identity.
Do not alter remote configuration or perform a malicious/outbound push merely to demonstrate this governance control.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped scoped Codex Security review of the 35 governance paths; final report and deterministic work ledger

evidence_limitations: The review deliberately did not mutate origin.pushurl, push to any remote, or claim runtime enforcement. It proves the former policy omission and the current local policy/audit remediation only.
root_cause: The Parent policy mislabeled its Git authority and referenced missing routes; Parent and Framework delivery treated remote display as sufficient evidence rather than binding the effective push destination and GitHub repository identity at every remote-action boundary.
root_cause_de: Die Parent-Policy bezeichnete ihre Git-Autorität falsch und verwies auf fehlende Routen; Parent- und Framework-Delivery behandelten die Remote-Anzeige als ausreichende Evidence, statt das effektive Push-Ziel und die GitHub-Repository-Identität an jeder Remote-Aktionsgrenze zu binden.
proposed_remediation: Add repository-local fork-and-upstream policies with accepted HTTPS/SSH URLs, effective-push URL and GitHub identity/permission/default-branch preflight, route AGENTS/Git/delivery/restoration through them, and require blocked_remote_mismatch on any discrepancy. Preserve normal task-branch origin delivery and prohibit upstream delivery/deletion.
proposed_remediation_de: Repository-lokale Fork-and-Upstream-Policies mit akzeptierten HTTPS/SSH-URLs, effektiver Push-URL sowie GitHub-Identitäts-/Berechtigungs-/Default-Branch-Preflight hinzufügen, AGENTS/Git/Delivery/Restoration darüber routen und bei jeder Abweichung blocked_remote_mismatch verlangen. Normale Task-Branch-Origin-Delivery bleibt erhalten; Upstream-Delivery/-Löschung bleibt verboten.
acceptance_criteria: Parent and Framework instructions require the exact expected origin fetch and effective push URLs plus GitHub identity, permission, archive, and default-branch readback before a delivery branch, push, PR action, or remote deletion.
A mismatch is explicitly blocked without a remote rewrite, fallback push, PR creation, or remote deletion.
MRTS retains its stricter independent Easton97-Jens/MRTS origin-only rule and no policy grants an upstream push/delete or Gitlink update.
Parent and Framework local policy audits and their focused tests pass.
validation_plan: Completed locally: Parent audit all and 57 focused audit tests passed after the policy updates.
Completed locally: Framework audit and 22 focused audit tests passed, including a git-policy weakening fixture.
Before any future remote action, execute the fresh live repository preflight; policy text/audit success alone is not a delivery authorization or runtime remote-control proof.
legitimate_control_tests: Observed Parent, Framework, and MRTS origin fetch/effective-push URLs match their expected repositories at the task preflight.
The valid Framework control-plane fixture remains consistent while a direct-master weakening in git-policy.md is detected.
residual_risk: The policies and local audits are governance controls, not host-side interceptors. A future authorized delivery must still perform and retain the required live remote/GitHub readback; no remote rewrite, upstream push, or default-branch push was performed here.
residual_risk_de: Die Policies und lokalen Audits sind Governance-Kontrollen, keine Host-seitigen Interceptoren. Eine künftige autorisierte Delivery muss weiterhin den erforderlichen Live-Remote-/GitHub-Readback ausführen und aufbewahren; hier erfolgten weder Remote-Umschreibung noch Upstream- oder Default-Branch-Push.

history.detail: The deterministic 35-path security review recorded the missing effective-push/repository-identity binding as low-severity FND-CROSS-0007.
Parent and Framework fork/upstream, Git, delivery, restoration, cleanup, and routing controls were updated. Parent audit/tests and Framework audit/tests passed; no remote state was changed.
